question_text: Was Best Egg hacked in October 2026?
answer_text: Yes, by its own account. Best Egg says an unauthorized third party got into its Financial Health platform on Oct 25-26 and took records including names, dates of birth and Social Security numbers. It began notifying people on Nov 24.
label: Confirmed

question_text: What should I do if I got a Best Egg breach letter?
answer_text: Best Egg offers 24 months of free Experian IdentityWorks monitoring; the code in the letter works until March 31, 2027.
label: Confirmed

question_text: How many people were affected by the Best Egg breach?
answer_text: About 792,000 records, American Banker reports. Best Egg's own notice gives no total; Texas lists 74,013 Texans.
label: Reported

question_text: How did the intruder get into Best Egg's platform?
what_would_settle_it: Best Egg has not said. Best Egg, a regulator or law enforcement saying how access was gained would settle it.

question_text: Is the Barclays applicant data incident part of the Best Egg breach?
answer_text: Barclays says no: the Barclays Bank Delaware incident, found on Nov 4 in a tool for card applicants, is unrelated. That is its word; nobody outside has checked.
label: Reported
